description: This file defines an Agent class for managing AI agents, including client initialization, task execution, and tool management, within a Playwright-based environment.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: A class representing an AI agent that manages tools, clients, and task execution within a specified loop environment.

methods.name: runTask
methods.description: Executes a task with given parameters and optional logging, returning the output of the task.

methods.name: _initClients
methods.description: Initializes and verifies clients and tools, preparing them for task execution.

methods.name: _disconnectFromServers
methods.description: Closes all client connections to servers.
